title: ModelOutput
description: The dialogue the model must return. Self-contained (no external $ref) so it can be passed directly to Ollama's `format` parameter.

story_title.description: Title copied from the input story.

language.description: Language the dialogue is written in.

dialogue.description: Ordered turns. Alternation is not enforced by the schema, only by the prompt.

speaker.description: Must be the `name` of one of the input characters.

text.description: Spoken words only, without the speaker name or quotation marks.

stage_direction.description: Optional action/gesture, equivalent to the parenthetical in '(checks his pocket watch)'.
